data.rationale: The proposal captures the same procedure (Plan Travel > Flights, choose search type, enter From/To/Depart per leg with suggestion picks, add another flight, search, sort), but it is generic: it leaves the segments as separate origin/destination/date parameters rather than a list, and it puts sort after Search without naming the sort value, so an automation would need to guess some details.
